content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology, Bhopal, has released for recruitment of 55 Group B and Group C Non-Teaching posts. The detailed 55-page notification includes vacancy distribution, educational qualifications, age requirements, fees, reservation, recruitment rules, PwBD provisions, selection procedures and general application instructions. Official Notification PDF: Download MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026 Notification

content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Important: The online application link will be disabled after the closing date. Candidates should complete their registration, document uploads and fee payment well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical difficulties.

content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching Vacancy 2026 - 55 Posts
content_sections.text: The institute has announced 55 vacancies across eight Group B and Group C positions. Technical and administrative posts are available under different pay levels. Reservation Note: The advertised vacancies include backlog positions and horizontal reservation for eligible Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Ex-Servicemen. These are horizontal reservations included within the total 55 vacancies and must not be added separately.

content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the educational qualification and other eligibility requirements prescribed under the Recruitment Rules, 2019 for Non-Teaching Staff in National Institutes of Technology . The academic and technical qualifications vary by post. Candidates must satisfy all essential conditions as on 10 December 2026 . Candidates applying for the 6 Junior Assistant vacancies must have passed Class 12 from a recognized Board. They must also have a minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute and proficiency in computer word processing and spreadsheet applications. Knowledge of additional computer applications and stenography is desirable but not listed as an essential qualification. Applicants must have passed Class 12 and possess a minimum typing speed of 35 WPM, along with proficiency in computer word processing and spreadsheets. Additional computer skills, stenography and a Bachelor's degree are desirable qualifications. The institute has advertised 4 Technical Assistant posts under Pay Level 6. Applicants must possess one of the following qualifications: First Class B.E./B.Tech. or MCA in the relevant subject. First Class Engineering Diploma in the relevant field with excellent academic record. First Class Bachelor's Degree in Science. Master's Degree in Science with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade. Candidates must also satisfy the trade, field or specialization conditions specified in Annexure-II. The institute accepts the following alternative qualifications for Senior Technician and Technician posts: Class 12 with Science and at least 60% marks. Class 12 with at least 50% marks and ITI qualification of one year or longer in the appropriate trade. Class 10 with at least 60% marks and two-year ITI certificate in the appropriate trade. Three-year Engineering Diploma in the relevant field from a recognized institution. Applicants must choose the correct specialization and satisfy the applicable trade requirements. Yes. Class 12 pass candidates may apply for Junior Assistant and Senior Assistant posts if they meet the typing and computer proficiency requirements. Candidates with Class 12 Science may also qualify for certain Technician and Senior Technician positions, subject to the required marks and specialization. Yes. Relevant ITI or Engineering Diploma qualifications are accepted for specified technical posts. However, eligibility depends on the relevant trade and minimum marks, where prescribed.

content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive salaries according to the 7th Central Pay Commission pay matrix for their respective positions. Salary Clarification: These are basic pay amounts, not guaranteed in-hand salaries. Eligible employees may receive applicable allowances and benefits according to institute and Central Government rules.

content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official notification prescribes separate application fees, processing charges and GST. Important: SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from the application fee but must pay the processing charges and applicable GST. Candidates applying for multiple posts or multiple trades/fields/specializations must submit separate application forms and pay the applicable charges separately. Application fees and processing charges are non-refundable and non-transferable.

content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: MANIT Bhopal may conduct a multi-stage selection process depending on the number of applicants, post requirements and applicable recruitment rules. Online application submission. Scrutiny and shortlisting of eligible applications. Screening Test, if conducted. Written Examination, if applicable. Skill Test or Trade Test, where required. Document verification. Final selection according to the notified criteria. The institute may conduct a Written Test, Screening Test and/or Skill or Trade Test. MANIT will publish the detailed examination scheme separately on its official website. The examination is planned to be conducted in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh . However, if the number of applications is large, the institute may also conduct the Screening Test in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, and New Delhi . The specific examination venue and date will be communicated later. Requests for a change of examination date or venue will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Candidates can submit applications through the official MANIT Bhopal recruitment portal. Direct Apply Link: MANIT Bhopal Online Application Form Application Start Date: 13 November 2026. Application Last Date: 10 December 2026. Only online applications are accepted. Candidates must not send a printed application form to MANIT Bhopal.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep the following documents ready for application and later verification, where applicable: Class 10 certificate or accepted proof of date of birth. Class 12 certificate and marksheet. Relevant ITI or Engineering Diploma certificate. Bachelor's Degree certificate and academic marksheets. Master's Degree or MCA certificate, where applicable. CGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate, if required. Category certificate for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates. PwBD certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen certificate, where applicable. Relevant work experience certificates, where prescribed. Sports and extracurricular activity certificates for SAS Assistant, where applicable. No Objection Certificate-cum-Vigilance Clearance for currently employed candidates, where required. Valid Government-issued photo identity proof. Other documents supporting information entered in the application. Completed application printout and payment receipt. The institute will consider OBC-NCL and EWS certificates issued on or after 1 April 2026 , subject to the prescribed Central Government formats and eligibility conditions. Candidates claiming OBC-NCL reservation must belong to a community included in the applicable Central OBC list and satisfy the Non-Creamy Layer requirements.
